senses.sense_definition: A respected political leader who is known for wisdom, integrity, and dedication to the public good.

examples.text: The retired president was widely regarded as a true <w>statesman</w> who always put the country first.
He acted like a <w>statesman</w> during the crisis, focusing on unity rather than partisan politics.

senses.sense_definition: A man who holds a prominent position in national or international government affairs.

examples.text: Many foreign <w>statesmen</w> attended the international summit to discuss the new trade agreement.
The diplomat was a seasoned <w>statesman</w> with decades of experience in global negotiations.

senses.sense_definition: A man who owns and manages a small landed estate.

examples.text: In the eighteenth century, the local <w>statesman</w> managed his small farm with great care.
The historical records describe him as a modest <w>statesman</w> living on his family property.

traits.comment: Refers to a historical sense of a small landholder.
